notes.title: Fix many bugs
notes.content:
- Add campfires at checkpoints
- Fixed fall when returning to one of the levels of the castle
- Water lake fully restores health

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
Fix character spawning in the cave forest from main menu
 Added tooltip for level 2
 Added workbench at level 3

notes.title: Fresh bones
notes.content:
Graphics:

 Changed the background on some locations
 Changed texture effects
 Changed the textures of the mansion


Levels:

 Changed the cave after the forest
 First levels have been partially remade
 Fixed locations of the castle


Weapon balance:

 Now you always have at least one cartridge. Just recharge.
